title: Open 12.1
creator: CrossFit Games
description: Seven minutes of burpees, as many as possible, each one finishing with a two-hand touch on a target 6 in above your reach. No equipment, no strategy, only pacing. Score is total burpees.

source.title: CrossFit Games Open 2012 – Workout 12.1
source.author: CrossFit Games
source.license: Public competition workout; description in our own words

steps.note: Jump and touch a target 6 in above max reach. Score = total burpees in 7 minutes.
